integrity: The proof is analytical. Exact enumeration tests 216 rational configurations and 9 distinct two-result equivalence constructions; computation does not replace the unrestricted proof. Full 2004 comparison text was inaccessible and the resulting bibliographic risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Structural population-law identification only: one fixed-composition population, homogeneous and conditionally independent assay errors, uniform distinct-person sampling, known population size, interior prevalence and a>b. No finite-sample accuracy, robust heterogeneous-error inference, or empirical validation. In large populations the identifying second/third cross-moments are small.
title: Three distinct finite-population assays identify prevalence and both error rates without a gold standard
